blurb: Guests can enjoy wakeboarding, water skiing, tubing, and non-motorized boat rentals including kayaks and paddle boards on Lake Harmony. The business offers hourly group rates for motorized boats with instructors and equipment included. A two-boat option accommodates up to 21 people for larger groups with one boat for watersports and one pontoon for relaxing and swimming.

quotes.author: Morgan
quotes.text: My experience with Lake Harmony Watersports was unforgettable! The lake was beautiful and the instructor was awesome! When we weren’t riding we were able to relax on the boat and swim in the lake. Wakeboarding on Lake Harmony was the highlight of my summer and I am excited to go back!
Rob taught me and my son how to water ski. He is friendly and motivating.
